summary: Axe Compute Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing a September 30, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Duos Edge AI GPUaaS, LLC from Duos Technologies Group. Consideration comprised repayment of approximately $87.8 million of SPV debt plus a deferred purchase price of $715,000 per month for 60 months, payable within 12 months post-closing or upon financing secured by the 288-server cluster. The acquisition closed immediately. The filing provided no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or shareholder vote details. Watch the short-term financing obligation and any secured debt overhang on the GPU cluster.
